basic_details.job_title: MGUG Security Guard Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University (Mahayogi Gorakhnath Vishwavidyalaya), Gorakhpur needs Security Guards, with the number of posts given as "as per requirement". Interested candidates may submit their biodata and the necessary documents at the university's HR office by 05 December 2026. The notice was issued under Advertisement No. MGUG/Recruitment/2026/11/008, dated 19 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About MGUG Security Guard
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University is a university in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, located at Arogya Dham, Sonbarsa, Balapar Road, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh-273007, as printed on its letterhead. The Security Guards will be posted at the university's own campus in Gorakhpur to look after its security and discipline.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may submit their biodata and the necessary documents at the HR office of Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur by 05 December 2026. The notice does not prescribe an application form or a postal mode; it asks only for the biodata and documents to be submitted at the HR office. The university's address on the letterhead is Arogya Dham, Sonbarsa, Balapar Road, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh-273007.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Security Guard (Suraksha Guard). The number of posts is not fixed; it is given as "as per requirement". Eligibility: The candidate must be physically and mentally fit and capable of security work. Preference: Candidates with experience in security work, surveillance and campus security will be given preference. Pay: As per qualification and on the basis of experience. No amount is printed. Place of work: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: MGUG Security Guard Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following duties for the Security Guard: Ensure the security and discipline arrangements of the university/institution campus. Monitor and properly check visitors, employees and vehicles at the entrance gate. Keep a vigilant watch on activities taking place on the campus. Maintain security registers, log books and other necessary records. Perform security duties according to the prescribed shift.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process printed in the notice is Interview / Physical Test. The notice also states that selected candidates will be invited for an interview.
